g.text: Zabbix (Hugin): host and LXC monitoring outside K3s
When K3s is the thing on fire, Zabbix is what tells us. Single LXC; the database behind it is the HA part.
Hugin LXC on Urd · outside K3s
plain http, TLS ends at Traefik
Why a separate LXC on Urd: Skuld already carries too much and freezes.
Losing Hugin pauses collection until it returns; stored data survives in Patroni.
SAML only works on hugin.xiiisins.com: the ACS URL is pinned to one host.
Sources: docs/services/zabbix.md, docs/services/notifications.md. Zabbix history is long-term and low-resolution; VictoriaMetrics is for the K8s layer.
